example.blue: <line>Blue Line</line>: Delays of about <duration>20 minutes</duration> due to a <reason>power issue</reason> near wood island. Some trains may hold at stations.
example.orange: <line>Orange Line</line>: Delays of about <duration>10 minutes</duration> due to a <reason>disabled train</reason> at Northeastern.
example.green: <line>Green Line D Branch</line>: Delays of about <duration>10 minutes</duration> eastbound due to a maintenance train <reason>inspecting the overhead</reason> between riverside and kenmore.

notes.body: When there's a delay on the T, the MBTA sends out an alert to riders. These alerts almost always include a reason for the delay, and an estimate of how long trains may be delayed. We collect these alerts and group them by general matching categories, and add up the total delay time to riders in a week.
